# AGENTS.md — grok-webui (Grok Build)

## This seat

Skills under `.grok/skills` (default: `leaf-wiki`).
Roadmap default: `docs/next-steps.md`.

## Parallelism

Subagents are available. Isolation defaults to **shared workspace**.
For parallel file writers: spawn with `isolation: worktree`, or use disjoint PATHS.

## Work tiers

| Tier | When | Flow |
|------|------|------|
| **S** | ≤~2 files, low blast radius | implement → verify → package-complete if contracts changed |
| **M** | one-stack multi-file | implement → verify; critic mindset if API/auth/secrets/prod; then package-complete |
| **L** | security, multi-module, ambiguous design | short plan → implement → verify → critic on diff → package-complete |

Work package shape:

```text
GOAL: ...
PATHS: file/or/dir ...
ACCEPT:
- measurable check
SKILLS: skill-name ...
TIER: S|M|L
```

If unclear: ask once, default **M**. Prefer the smallest coherent package.

## Done

For **M/L** (and **S** that changes architecture/auth/security contracts):

1. Append `.wiki/log.md`
2. Write `.wiki/beliefs/<id>.md`, then print exactly:
   `BELIEF: .wiki/beliefs/<id>.md`
3. Print exactly one:
   `PROMOTE queued: <yaml>` or `PROMOTE skipped: leaf-only — <reason>`

These are machine footer lines: own line, exact `BELIEF:` / `PROMOTE` spelling, no markdown, no title-case `Belief:`, no backticks, no trailing period. Watchers do not fix decoration. Self-check OUT for `^BELIEF: ` and one `PROMOTE` line before claiming done.

```text
BELIEF: .wiki/beliefs/<session-id>.md
PROMOTE queued: .wiki/_meta/promotion-queue/<file>.yaml
```

or:

```text
BELIEF: .wiki/beliefs/<session-id>.md
PROMOTE skipped: leaf-only — <one-line reason>
```

A log append alone is not done. Belief files stay leaf-only (never promote YAML).
Wiki root is `.wiki/`. Use skill `leaf-wiki`.

## Verify / critic

- Verify with real commands; do not invent results.
- Suggested verify: `npm test`, `npm run check`.
- Critic mindset on L and on M touching auth/secrets/API/prod.

## Wiki

Root `.wiki/`. Belief files under `.wiki/beliefs/` (leaf-only; never promote as YAML).
Promote durable cross-project articles via leaf-wiki queue YAML when warranted.

## Safety

Keep secrets and personal data out of prompts.
